readPublic: async () => await csrTab.playwright.evaluate(() => { const host=document.querySelector('.publication-scene'); const svg=host?.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) throw new Error('No visible current scene'); return {capturedAt:new Date().toISOString(),url:document.URL,revision:Number(host.getAttribute('data-committed-revision')),kind:host.getAttribute('data-scene-kind'),expandedIds:JSON.parse(host.getAttribute('data-expanded-ids')),pinnedIds:JSON.parse(host.getAttribute('data-pinned-ids')),svg:svg.outerHTML,metadata:JSON.parse(svg.querySelector('metadata').textContent),paperTransform:document.querySelector('.paper').getAttribute('style'),viewport:{width:window.innerWidth,height:window.innerHeight},assetUrls:[...document.querySelectorAll('script[src],link[rel=stylesheet]')].map(e=>e.src||e.href),edges:[...svg.querySelectorAll('[data-edge-id]')].map(e=>({id:e.getAttribute('data-edge-id'),path:e.querySelector('path').getAttribute('d')})),zoom:document.querySelector('.zoom-value').textContent}; })
start: async (caseId,view) => {const before=await csrReadPublic(); await csrWriteJson(csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/'+view+'-before.json',before);const bytes=await csrTab.getScreenshot({emit:false});const ext=bytes[0]===255&&bytes[1]===216?'jpg':'png';await csrFs.writeFile(csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/'+view+'.'+ext,bytes,{flag:'wx'});return {caseId,view,bytes:bytes.length,revision:before.revision,zoom:before.zoom};}
finish: async (caseId,view) => {const after=await csrReadPublic();const before=JSON.parse(await csrFs.readFile(csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/'+view+'-before.json','utf8'));if(before.svg!==after.svg||before.paperTransform!==after.paperTransform||before.revision!==after.revision)throw new Error('Captured state changed');await csrWriteJson(csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/'+view+'-after.json',after);return {caseId,view,domBeforeAfterExact:true,revision:after.revision,zoom:after.zoom};}
export: async caseId => {const href=await csrTab.playwright.getByRole('link',{name:'查看 SVG',exact:true}).getAttribute('href');const uuid=href.split('/')[3];const source='/home/fzg/PycharmProjects/ArchCanvas/ArchCanvas_Model_Architecture_Studio/.archcanvas/m4-collapsed-residual-session/exports/'+uuid;const fileNames=['figure.svg','figure.svg.receipt.json','document.json'];for(const name of fileNames)await csrFs.copyFile(source+'/'+name,csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/'+name,csrFs.constants.COPYFILE_EXCL);const doc=JSON.parse(await csrFs.readFile(source+'/document.json','utf8'));const current=await csrReadPublic();if(doc.id!==current.metadata.documentId||doc.revision!==current.revision)throw new Error('Export does not bind current revision');const envelopePath='/home/fzg/PycharmProjects/ArchCanvas/ArchCanvas_Model_Architecture_Studio/.archcanvas/m4-collapsed-residual-session/documents/'+doc.id+'.json';const envelopeText=await csrFs.readFile(envelopePath,'utf8');const env=JSON.parse(envelopeText);const stable=v=>Array.isArray(v)?v.map(stable):v&&typeof v==='object'?Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).sort().map(k=>[k,stable(v[k])])):v;if(JSON.stringify(stable(env.document))!==JSON.stringify(stable(doc)))throw new Error('Saved export canvas mismatch');await csrFs.writeFile(csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/saved-envelope.json',envelopeText,{flag:'wx'});await csrWriteJson(csrBrowserDir+'/'+caseId+'/export-binding.json',{caseId,href,uuid,revision:doc.revision,storageRevision:env.revision,savedExportCanvasExact:true,currentRevisionMatched:true,actualFiles:fileNames,sourceDirectory:source});return {caseId,href,revision:doc.revision,storageRevision:env.revision};}
